data_checks.sentinel_handling: -999 treated as missing (NaN) before clipping and standardizing; for duplicate event_ids I kept the copy with the fewest missing features
data_checks.exits_note: primary tests only use issuers that have outcome rows; as a robustness check, defaulted and distressed-exchange issuers without outcome rows were counted as deteriorated
data_checks.point_in_time: only events published inside their event month are used; later revisions are excluded
data_checks.issuer_id_normalized: issuer ids lowercased and stripped before every join
